title: 2009 is going to be a great year because ...
html:
2009 is going to be a great year because…

I have used that line for the past few years to get me thinking about the year ahead. I take some time to myself, 15 minutes will do, write that at the top of an A4 page and start writing for a full five minutes, non-stop.

I never think ‘that's too big’, or ‘that's impossible, I wont write that’, instead I just write whatever pops into my head. Write anything from; having more time to do things you want to do, or more sales, or more money, or more love, don't put any limits on yourself and just write.

Doing this exercise gets your brain going after its hiatus between Christmas and New Year and, from it, you can work out the things you would really like to do in 2009. I pick out several that are the most important to me and then have a think about what I can do in the next few weeks to achieve that goal by the end of the year.

It might be as simple as making a call or searching the internet. There will always be a first step that you can do now. Do it now and make 2009 a great year because…
